blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Unbeaten boxing prospect Criztian Pitt “Golden Boy” Laurente will face his first acid test and fight abroad for the first time this December. Laurente will see action in Australia, a tough destination for Filipino boxers who have often suffered defeats against hometown fighters. However, the 26-year-old Laurente will try to flip that script when he faces a more experienced Australian opponent, Nathaniel May, in a 10-round, non-title bout on December 19 at the Fortitude Music Hall in Brisbane.
